question: As of July 2025, the Power Finance Corporation holds which of the following CPSE status?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharatna**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Power Finance Corporation (PFC)** was accorded the **Maharatna status** by the **Government of India in July 2023**, acknowledging its outstanding performance and strategic importance in the power sector. 
• The **Maharatna status** is the highest recognition for **Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs)**, providing greater **autonomy** and **financial powers** to the enterprise. 
• PFC plays a significant role in financing **power generation, transmission, and distribution projects** across India, contributing to the development of the country’s energy infrastructure. 
• To qualify for **Maharatna status**, a CPSE must meet specific financial and operational benchmarks, including an annual turnover exceeding **₹25,000 crores**, net profit exceeding **₹5,000 crores**, and an average annual net worth exceeding **₹15,000 crores** over three consecutive years.
